identity.name: The Irrawaddy
identity.description: An independent Myanmar-focused news organisation founded by Burmese exiles, covering the military, democracy movement, ethnic conflicts and regional affairs.

ownership.ownershipNotes: Founded in 1990 by Burmese exiles in Thailand. Independent of the Myanmar military government and associated with the pro-democracy movement, though not formally aligned with any political party.

editorialOrientation.evidence: Exile-founded newsroom with a documented pro-democracy orientation and no affiliation to the military government; it is openly opposed to the junta.
editorialOrientation.source: Ownership and self-description via Official about page; secondary references; feed-level sample

politicalLeaning.evidence: No parsed MBFC rating; self-assessed as centre-left on rights and democracy issues, with a strongly anti-junta editorial stance.
politicalLeaning.source: Analyst assessment from publisher self-description, secondary references and feed-level sample

economicPerspective.evidence: Economic coverage is secondary and framed through conflict, sanctions and development impacts.
economicPerspective.source: Analyst assessment from business and economic coverage

internationalAlignment.evidence: Clear pro-democracy, anti-junta alignment alongside coverage of ethnic armed groups and regional diplomacy.
internationalAlignment.source: Ownership, editorial positioning and regional coverage sample

reliability.evidence: Established independent Myanmar newsroom with named reporters and a long track record; no external rating parsed.
reliability.source: Analyst assessment from ownership, editorial record and feed-level sample

externalRatings.notes: No MBFC rating identified for The Irrawaddy.

intelligence.knownPerspective: Myanmar-focused independent journalism with a pro-democracy lens. It explains events through military power, ethnic conflict, resistance politics and regional spillover.

selectionRationale: Adds specialist Myanmar coverage and a Southeast Asian civil-society perspective that global wires cannot provide.

feeds.validationNote: 10 items; feed parser reported bozo=True but returned dated entries. Monitor XML validity.

research.researchNotes: Official About page accessible. Feed returned valid items but parser warning; needs monitoring before activation. Research is feed-level only; full article sampling and peer review remain outstanding.
